text:
Big news, team: we just turned a routine database migration into a learning moment! 🚀 During a recent deploy, an ALTER TABLE statement added a brand-new NOT NULL column with a default value. That single change locked the table for a full 6 minutes, and during that window, 2,300 checkout requests failed. We know how much every one of those customers matters, and we're sorry for the disruption!

Here's the exciting part: we've turned this into a roadmap of wins. 🎯 Going forward, every schema change gets reviewed for lock impact before it ships. We're adopting expand-and-contract patterns: add the column as nullable, backfill in small batches, then enforce the constraint once the data is ready. We're also adding lock timeouts to migration tooling so a blocked statement fails fast instead of stalling production.

Our checkout experience is the heart of what we do, and we're committed to protecting it. ✨ Thank you for your patience, and for being part of a team that owns its mistakes and levels up every time!
